recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The original description-broadening request is already satisfied, and later ISO 3166 URI/ValueSet maintenance has dedicated issues already audited on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-13560 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request asking FHIR-core to stop describing urn:iso:std:iso:3166 as only a country-code system and to clarify coverage of countries plus sub-regions, with related URI and ValueSet updates for the ISO 3166 parts.
initial_application: No commit was found that names FHIR-13560 directly. The apparent application is 4c41b4e23383efa8df22cf99fdc0511105015c5b, "rework ISO 3166", which changed source/terminologies-systems.html from "ISO 2 letter Country Codes" to "ISO Country & Regional Codes", replaced the stale country-code prose with a usage-page link, and added ISO 3166 Part 1 ValueSet sources.
additional_context: The 2018-02-08 Vocabulary WG minutes say the ISO 3166 motion superseded GF#13560: retain urn:iso:std:iso:3166 for ISO 3166 Part 1 for legacy reasons, document the ISO 3166 usage policy, and create a ValueSet for alpha-2 codes. Later Published issue FHIR-37887 added urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-2 and urn:iso:std:iso:3166:-3 and removed the obsolete OID from the same row. FHIR-13330 and FHIR-37971 are related ISO 3166 ValueSet issues already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/terminologies-systems.html already says "ISO Country & Regional Codes", lists the base ISO 3166 URI plus Part 2 and Part 3 URNs, and links to THO's ISO 3166 usage page. publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml keep the page in the build, and source/fhir.ini actively registers the ISO 3166 Part 1 ValueSet source files.

related_jiras.note: Resolved in the same 2018 Vocabulary motion and created the ISO 3166 Part 1 alpha-2 ValueSet; already audited on the combined branch.
Added ISO 3166 Part 2 and Part 3 URNs to the same terminology systems row and removed the obsolete OID; already audited on the combined branch.
Refined the ISO 3166 Part 1 two-letter ValueSet CLD to a regex include; already audited on the combined branch.
